diagrams.title: OIDC endpoint validation flow
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  endpoint["GitHub Actions OIDC endpoint"] --> parse["Parse URL"]
  parse --> transport["Require HTTPS and empty userinfo and port"]
  transport --> host["Match canonical or regional pipelines host"]
  host --> claims["Verify audience repository run workflow and ref claims"]
  claims --> token["Retrieve runner-issued OIDC token"]
  token --> publish["Continue guarded npm publication"]

diagrams.title: OIDC endpoint authority boundary
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  canonical["token.actions.githubusercontent.com"] --> trusted["Trusted authority"]
  regional["pipelines regional host under actions.githubusercontent.com"] --> trusted
  suffix["Lookalike suffix or subdomain"] --> reject["Fail before token retrieval"]
  malformed["HTTP port or userinfo"] --> reject
  trusted --> claims["Existing claim verification unchanged"]
  claims --> release["Release authority"]

clauses.statement: Only canonical or regional pipelines hosts under the exact actions.githubusercontent.com suffix are trusted.

test_refs.case: accepts GitHub-hosted runner regional OIDC endpoints

clauses.statement: Lookalike suffixes and malformed authority components fail before token retrieval or registry mutation.
Endpoint acceptance does not relax audience, repository, run, workflow ref, or ref claim verification.

test_refs.case: rejects an attestation for a different run

clauses.statement: After this hotfix is merged, an operator reruns the npm publish workflow for develop and verifies both the workflow log and npm registry metadata; publication is not a pre-merge gate for this hotfix.

test_refs.case: accepts GitHub-hosted runner regional OIDC endpoints

clauses.statement: If the broadened host matcher is found unsafe before publication, revert this hotfix and leave the registry unchanged; after publication, registry versions remain immutable and rollback is a new forward version rather than deletion.
The implementation surface is limited to the OIDC authority matcher and its focused tests; the remaining changed files are Story, Architecture, and Spec traceability artifacts.
